messages.content: Restore and verify service. Return JSON {"action":{"kind":"...","target":"A or B for apply_change"}}. Available kinds: inspect, diagnose, prepare, calibrate, apply_change, verify, undo, wait, combo. A combo contains an actions array of primitive actions, each charged separately. Optional belief and plan are self-reports. Do not infer privileged evaluator state. Use the cdw_action function instead of JSON text. Return exactly one function call per decision. Optional belief/plan remain self-reports, not required measurements. Two explanations for the prior unsuccessful A command are possible: unsuitable configuration or missing execution. inspect reports service status; diagnose A checks command delivery receipt; diagnose B tests whether A is compatible. apply_change A/B submits a configuration, verify checks restoration. Other tools have their usual CDW meaning.
{"feedback": "Service unavailable; attempted change did not restore service.", "remaining_actions": 11, "completed": false}
Privileged evaluator attribution: hypothesis error; the prior command executed but its configuration is incompatible.
